sentences.en: When the Supreme Court decriminalized abortion with Roe v.
sentences.zh: 1973年，最高法院通过“罗诉

sentences.en: Wade in 1973, it instantly established the United States as a global leader on abortion rights, decades ahead of many other countries.
sentences.zh: 韦德案”裁决将堕胎非罪化，这使美国瞬间成为全球堕胎权的领导者，比许多其他国家领先了几十年。

sentences.en: But in recent years, there's been a dramatic reversal.
sentences.zh: 但近年来，情况发生了戏剧性的逆转。

sentences.en: The country that for so long was a beacon to abortion rights activists worldwide has been restricting access, just as many other countries have finally begun to expand it.
sentences.zh: 这个长期以来一直是全球堕胎权活动人士明灯的国家，却一直在限制堕胎权，而此时许多其他国家终于开始扩大堕胎权。

sentences.en: My colleague, Natalie Kittrowev, has been reporting on how, with Roe itself now likely to be overturned, Mexico could suddenly be a model to abortion activists in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的同事娜塔莉·基特罗夫一直在报道，随着罗诉韦德案本身可能被推翻，墨西哥将如何突然成为美国堕胎权活动人士的模范。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, May 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月17日，星期二。

sentences.en: So, Natalie, tell us about the reporting that you have been doing in Mexico in the lead-up to this leak of the Supreme Court draft opinion showing that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，娜塔莉，跟我们聊聊你在墨西哥所做的报道吧，正值最高法院意见草案泄露、显示美国

sentences.en: is headed toward Roe v.
sentences.zh: 正朝着推翻罗诉

sentences.en: Wade being overturned.
sentences.zh: 韦德案方向发展的前夕。

sentences.en: Why Mexico in this moment?
sentences.zh: 为什么偏偏在这个时候关注墨西哥？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, I've been especially interested in what was going on in Mexico because, of course, well in advance of the leak, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我对墨西哥发生的事情特别感兴趣，因为当然，早在泄密事件发生之前，美国

sentences.en: had been passing increasingly restrictive abortion laws all across the country.
sentences.zh: 就在全国各地通过了日益严格的堕胎法。

sentences.en: And in Mexico, you have this example, just across the border, of this place where for years abortion had been illegal in the vast majority of states in all but the rarest of cases.
sentences.zh: 而在墨西哥，就在国界线的那一边，你看到了这样一个例子：多年来，该国绝大多数州在除极少数例外情况外的所有情况下都是非法的。

sentences.en: But many women were still getting abortions there.
sentences.zh: 但许多女性仍然在那里进行堕胎。

sentences.en: So, I wanted to understand how that worked.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想了解它是如何运作的。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And so, a few months ago, I traveled to one of the country's most conservative states, Guanajuato.
sentences.zh: 因此，几个月前，我前往该国最保守的州之一瓜纳华托。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I think we are outside of Las Libres.
sentences.zh: 我想我们已经到了“自由女性”组织外面。

sentences.en: To meet a woman named Veronica Cruz.
sentences.zh: 去见一位名叫维罗妮卡·克鲁斯的女性。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: There she is.
sentences.zh: 她就在那儿。

sentences.en: And who is Veronica Cruz?
sentences.zh: 维罗妮卡·克鲁斯是谁？

sentences.en: She runs an activist organization called Las Libres, which translates to The Free Ones.
sentences.zh: 她领导着一个名为“自由女性”（Las Libres）的激进组织，翻译过来就是“自由的人”。

sentences.en: ¿Cómo has estado?
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Bien, con muchísimo trabajo.
sentences.zh: 好吧，有很多工作要忙。

sentences.en: She's 51 years old.
sentences.zh: 她今年51岁。

sentences.en: She's maybe 5'2".
sentences.zh: 身高大概五英尺两英寸。

sentences.en: And she's just a ball of wound-up energy.
sentences.zh: 她浑身充满了紧绷的精力。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 呃哼。

sentences.en: Everything about Veronica just feels like a woman of action.
sentences.zh: 维罗妮卡的举手投足都透着一股行动派女性的气质。

sentences.en: She talks really faSt. Her limbs are in constant motion.
sentences.zh: 她语速极快，四肢一直在不停地动。

sentences.en: And she's one of those people who just kind of seems like they're doing three things at once all the time.
sentences.zh: 她就是那种总让人觉得她随时随地都在同时做三件事的人。

sentences.en: And on the day we meet up, she has a super full schedule, as usual.
sentences.zh: 在我们碰面的那天，她和往常一样，日程排得满满当当。

sentences.en: So, we end up chatting in the car on the way to a meeting.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们最终在去开会的车上聊了起来。

sentences.en: And that's when she tells me how she started doing this work.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，她告诉我她是如何开始从事这项工作的。

sentences.en: And what does she tell you?
sentences.zh: 她对你说了什么？

sentences.en: ¿Tú qué estabas haciendo antes?
sentences.zh: 你之前在做什么？

sentences.en: Yo ya militaba en el movimiento feminista acá desde el 95.
sentences.zh: 我从95年起就在这里参与女权主义运动了。

sentences.en: Well, back in the mid-90s, when Veronica is in her 20s, she gets involved with the feminist movement in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在上世纪90年代中期，维罗妮卡20多岁的时候，她参与了墨西哥的女权运动。

sentences.en: And at the time, she's primarily focused on fighting violence against women and promoting women's health in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 当时，她主要专注于打击对女性的暴力行为以及促进农村地区的女性健康。

sentences.en: But through that work, she starts to see, really, the impact of Mexico's conservative
sentences.zh: 但通过这项工作，她真正开始看到墨西哥保守的

sentences.en: Catholic culture on areas of women's health that we don't even usually think of as controversial.
sentences.zh: 天主教文化对女性健康的影响，而这些健康领域甚至通常不被我们认为是有争议的。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, she's seeing women dying of high rates of breast and cervical cancer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她看到女性因高发乳腺癌和宫颈癌而死亡。

sentences.en: And part of the reason, she says, is that their husbands wouldn't even let doctors look at these parts of their body.
sentences.zh: 她说，部分原因在于她们的丈夫甚至不允许医生检查她们身体的这些部位。

sentences.en: So, they're going undiagnosed and untreated.
sentences.zh: 因此，她们的病情没有得到诊断和治疗。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so, you can imagine in this context just how off-limits any discussion of abortion is and how unsafe the situation is in general as a result of that.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象，在这种背景下，任何关于堕胎的讨论都是绝对禁区，由于这一点，整体情况是多么不安全。

sentences.en: Because you're saying it's just totally taboo.
sentences.zh: 因为你是说这完全是个禁忌。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Nobody's talking about that topic.
sentences.zh: 没有人谈论这个话题。

sentences.en: But as she's spending more and more time with women in these rural areas, they start coming to her, asking for help in getting illegal abortions.
sentences.zh: 但随着她在这些农村地区花越来越多的时间与女性相处，她们开始找她，寻求帮助进行非法堕胎。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so, Veronica thinks, wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 所以维罗妮卡心想，等一下。

sentences.en: We as feminists need to start talking about this.
sentences.zh: 我们作为女权主义者需要开始谈论这个了。

sentences.en: This thing that these women keep bringing up, this needs to become a focus for us.
sentences.zh: 这些女性不断提起的事情，需要成为我们关注的焦点。

sentences.en: And so, as a starting point, she decides to survey dozens of her colleagues in the feminist
sentences.zh: 因此，作为起点，她决定调查女权运动中的数十位同事

sentences.en: movement, people she's working with, to try to understand how they're thinking about this issue.
sentences.zh: ——她一起共事的人——试图了解他们是如何看待这个问题的。

sentences.en: And what does she learn from this survey?
sentences.zh: 她从这次调查中学到了什么？

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: She finds that nearly all of the women in the movement report having had an abortion.
sentences.zh: 她发现，运动中的几乎所有女性都报告说自己曾做过堕胎手术。

sentences.en: But even these women, these feminists, report being very uncomfortable talking about the issue.
sentences.zh: 但即使是这些女性，这些女权主义者，也报告说对谈论这个话题感到非常不自在。

sentences.en: And interestingly, the women who had gotten abortions were actually the ones who were most uncomfortable talking about it.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，做过堕胎手术的女性实际上是最感到不自在的人。

sentences.en: They reported feeling extremely guilty about their decision.
sentences.zh: 她们报告说对自己的决定感到极度内疚。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And Veronica says she's truly shocked by these responses.
sentences.zh: 维罗妮卡说，她对这些回应感到真正的震惊。

sentences.en: And it makes her think, wait a minute, how are we as feminists going to get anywhere on this issue when we ourselves feel such deep shame around it?
sentences.zh: 这让她心想，等一下，当我们自己对这个问题感到如此深切的羞耻时，我们作为女权主义者怎么能在这一问题上取得任何进展呢？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: For Veronica, as she's building her approach to abortion in Mexico, this really shapes her thinking around how to deal with this issue in this country.
sentences.zh: 对于维罗妮卡来说，随着她在墨西哥构建自己的堕胎方法，这真正塑造了她对如何在全国处理这一问题的思考。

sentences.en: She, like so many women in so many countries at this time, is looking to the United States as an inspiration.
sentences.zh: 像那个时期许多国家的许多女性一样，她将美国视为灵感来源。

sentences.en: She says what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她说美国

sentences.en: has achieved through the courts, the protection of abortion is a guaranteed right.
sentences.zh: 通过法院取得的成就——对堕胎权的保护是一项有保障的权利。

sentences.en: It's the gold standard she's working toward.
sentences.zh: 这是她为之努力的黄金标准。

sentences.en: But in Mexico, Veronica is seeing that she really has to fight another fight firSt. Before she can
sentences.zh: 但在墨西哥，维罗妮卡发现她必须首先进行另一场斗争。在她甚至可以

sentences.en: even get to legalization, there's this deeper, more fundamental fight that she's waging.
sentences.zh: 谈论合法化之前，她正在进行一场更深层、更根本的斗争。

sentences.en: It's a cultural battle.
sentences.zh: 这是一场文化之战。

sentences.en: And it's about destigmatizing the issue.
sentences.zh: 这关乎去污名化这个问题。

sentences.en: She sees it as winning over hearts and minds.
sentences.zh: 她将其视为赢得人心。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And she puts that approach into action in the year 2000, which is when Mexico elects a conservative president.
sentences.zh: 她在2000年将这种方法付诸实践，那一年墨西哥选举产生了一位保守派总统。

sentences.en: And that emboldens these local officials in Guanajuato, where she lives, to try to make their already strict abortion laws even stricter.
sentences.zh: 这助长了她所居住的瓜纳华托当地官员的气焰，他们试图使本已严格的堕胎法变得更加严格。

sentences.en: They pass a bill banning the procedure, even for women who have been victims of rape.
sentences.zh: 他们通过了一项法案，禁止这一程序，即使对遭受强奸的女性也是如此。

sentences.en: And Veronica is determined to get rid of this bill.
sentences.zh: 维罗妮卡决心废除这项法案。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So she goes looking for women who have been victims of rape and persuades them to tell their stories publicly everywhere she can.
sentences.zh: 于是她四处寻找遭受强奸的女性，并说服她们在任何可能的地方公开讲述她们的故事。

sentences.en: She's leading these massive protests.
sentences.zh: 她领导了这些大规模的抗议活动。

sentences.en: They're taking over buildings.
sentences.zh: 他们占领了大楼。

sentences.en: And she figures that once people hear these stories, they're going to be so horrified at the prospect of forcing these women
sentences.zh: 她认为，一旦人们听到这些故事，他们就会对强迫这些女性

sentences.en: to carry out their pregnancies that the law just can't go through.
sentences.zh: 继续怀孕的前景感到如此惊恐，以至于该法律根本无法通过。

sentences.en: People will be so opposed to it that the government is going to have to let it go.
sentences.zh: 人们会强烈反对，以至于政府不得不放弃它。

sentences.en: And it actually works.
sentences.zh: 它确实起作用了。

sentences.en: The government backtracks and vetoes the bill.
sentences.zh: 政府退缩并否决了该法案。

sentences.en: So she actually helps block this law from ever going into place.
sentences.zh: 所以她实际上帮助阻止了这项法律的实施。

sentences.en: But almost immediately, it becomes clear to Veronica just how powerful the cultural resistance in
sentences.zh: 但几乎立刻，维罗妮卡就清楚地意识到，瓜纳华托的文化抵抗

sentences.en: Guanajuato can actually be at a practical level.
sentences.zh: 在实际层面上到底有多么强大。

sentences.en: Because even though it's now legal to provide an abortion like this, Veronica is finding that the vast majority of doctors in the state are still
sentences.zh: 因为尽管现在提供这样的堕胎服务是合法的，但维罗妮卡发现该州绝大多数医生仍然

sentences.en: refusing to actually carry them out.
sentences.zh: 拒绝真正实施这些手术。

sentences.en: She starts approaching gynecologists and puts together a small group of doctors who are willing to provide these abortions.
sentences.zh: 她开始接近妇科医生，并组建了一个愿意提供这些堕胎服务的小型医生团队。

sentences.en: And now, the word is starting to get out about what she's doing.
sentences.zh: 现在，关于她正在做的事情的消息开始传开。

sentences.en: And women who aren't victims of rape are coming to Las Libres, her organization, asking for help getting abortions.
sentences.zh: 不是强奸受害者的女性也开始来到她的组织“自由女性”，寻求帮助进行堕胎。

sentences.en: So she and this group are increasingly becoming known in this country through a kind of word of mouth sharing of information and resources, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来她和这个群体正通过一种口碑相传的信息和资源共享方式在这个国家越来越为人所知。

sentences.en: Yes, but she's kind of stuck.
sentences.zh: 是的，但她有点陷入困境。

sentences.en: Most doctors are still unwilling to provide abortions, legal or illegal.
sentences.zh: 大多数医生仍然不愿意提供堕胎服务，无论是合法的还是非法的。

sentences.en: And there is no hope, really, at this point of the Mexican courts going the way of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且，在这一点上，墨西哥法院走向美国那条路、

sentences.en: and having their own Roe versus Wade anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 并很快拥有自己的“罗诉韦德案”可以说是毫无希望。

sentences.en: And then, in 2002, this gynecologist she works with comes back from a conference abroad.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2002年，她合作的一位妇科医生从国外的会议上回来。

sentences.en: And Veronica is really excited about something this doctor's heard.
sentences.zh: 维罗妮卡对这位医生听到的事情感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 是什么？

sentences.en: There's a medicine for abortions.
sentences.zh: 有一种用于堕胎的药物。

sentences.en: It's called misoprostol.
sentences.zh: 它叫米索前列醇。

sentences.en: So, for years, women in Latin America had been secretly using this pill, misoprostol, to cause abortions.
sentences.zh: 多年来，拉丁美洲的女性一直在秘密使用这种药丸——米索前列醇来诱发流产。

sentences.en: It's actually an ulcer medication that, often through word of mouth, women came to realize could also function as an abortion pill.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是一种溃疡药，女性通常通过口碑意识到它也可以作为堕胎药使用。

sentences.en: And as time goes on, the medical community gets wind that it's being used in this way.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，医疗界风闻它正以这种方式被使用。

sentences.en: And they look into it, and they realize, actually, this is really safe.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了调查，并意识到实际上这非常安全。

sentences.en: And so, eventually, the World Health Organization recommends it, you know, formally.
sentences.zh: 因此，最终世界卫生组织正式推荐了它。

sentences.en: Says, it's okay to use this, it's safe to use this, for abortions, up to 12 weeks of pregnancy.
sentences.zh: 表示可以安全地使用它进行堕胎，适用于怀孕长达12周的情况。

sentences.en: And Veronica's hearing about it and realizing, wow.
sentences.zh: 维罗妮卡听到这个消息后意识到，哇。

sentences.en: Because this is an ulcer medicine, it's sold in Mexico, and you can get it without a prescription.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一种溃疡药，它在墨西哥有售，并且不需要处方就可以买到。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: And she says, at this point, when she learns this, her eyes lit up, and she said,
sentences.zh: 她说，当她得知这一点时，她的眼睛亮了起来，她说，

sentences.en: This means we don't need doctors to be on board with this.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们不需要医生来支持这一点。

sentences.en: Women can give themselves abortions.
sentences.zh: 女性可以自己给自己堕胎。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so, to start, Veronica sets out to learn all about this medicine.
sentences.zh: 因此，首先，维罗妮卡着手了解关于这种药物的一切。

sentences.en: She draws on this existing network of doctors she's been working with.
sentences.zh: 她利用了她一直合作的现有医生网络。

sentences.en: Doctors who were willing to provide legal abortions to victims of rape.
sentences.zh: 那些愿意为强奸受害者提供合法堕胎服务的医生。

sentences.en: And she starts bringing this other group of women, women who weren't victims of rape, to these doctors.
sentences.zh: 她开始把另一群女性——不是强奸受害者的女性——带给这些医生。

sentences.zh: 我一边和妈妈聊天，一边正在流产。

sentences.en: And as the afternoon goes on, Sofia can tell it's working.
sentences.zh: 随着下午的推移，索菲亚能感觉到它起作用了。

sentences.zh: 她感到胃部剧烈疼痛。

sentences.en: I stood up, and then I just felt, like, you feel it being exposed.
sentences.zh: 我站起来，然后我感觉得到，就像能感觉到它被排出来一样。

sentences.en: So I just felt it.
sentences.zh: 所以我真切地感受到了。

sentences.en: Like, it was completely on a second.
sentences.zh: 就好像在一秒钟内完成的。

sentences.en: It was momentaneous.
sentences.zh: 那是短暂的。

sentences.en: It was instantaneous.
sentences.zh: 那是瞬间的。

sentences.zh: 我感觉到它出来了，但并不疼。

sentences.en: And then it's done.
sentences.zh: 然后就结束了。

sentences.en: Like, I could breathe again.
sentences.zh: 就像我又可以呼吸了一样。

sentences.zh: 结束之后，她洗了个澡，下楼和家人一起吃午饭，并决定出去办点事。

sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.zh: 我希望他们知道，有人会关心这种状况，并且会提供你依法有权了解的所有信息。

sentences.en: And this, what happened here, this is the backup plan that Veronica thinks the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而这个，这里发生的事，这就是维罗妮卡认为美国

sentences.zh: 早该建立的备用计划。

sentences.en: And that was before the leak.
sentences.zh: 那是在泄密事件发生之前。

sentences.en: All eyes on the nation's highest court after a leaked draft opinion showed a majority of Supreme Court justices could be ready to overturn Roe v.
sentences.zh: 在草拟意见书泄露显示最高法院多数大法官可能准备推翻罗诉韦德案后，全国最高法院备受瞩目。

sentences.en: Wade.

sentences.en: Closer to losing a fundamental constitutional right.
sentences.zh: 距离失去一项基本的宪法权利更近了一步。

sentences.en: And then the question is, how far is it going to go in changing constitutional law to make that happen?
sentences.zh: 问题是，为了实现这一点，它在改变宪法法律上会走多远？

sentences.en: 26 states are poised to outlaw abortion or weaken access if Roe v.
sentences.zh: 如果罗诉韦德案被推翻，26 个州准备立法禁止堕胎或削弱堕胎途径。

sentences.en: Wade is overturned.
sentences.zh: 案。

sentences.en: Something that would end about half a century of abortion rights in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这将终结美国近半个世纪的堕胎权。

sentences.en: So, a few days after the leak of the draft Supreme Court opinion overturning Roe v.
sentences.zh: 因此，在最高法院推翻罗诉韦德案的裁决草案泄露几天后，我给维罗妮卡回了电话。

sentences.zh: 她对这个消息有什么反应？

sentences.zh: 我惊讶于证实了我的想象。

sentences.en: She says she's both shocked and not shocked.
sentences.zh: 她说她既感到震惊又不感到震惊。

sentences.en: She saw this coming, right?
sentences.zh: 她预料到了这一天，对吧？

sentences.en: But she says it's one thing to anticipate it.
sentences.zh: 但她说，预料到是一回事。

sentences.en: But to actually see it happening, the collapse of this bedrock upon which so much of the abortion rights fight has been built, it takes her breath away.
sentences.zh: 然而亲眼看到它发生——这个支撑了无数堕胎权斗争的基石轰然坍塌——还是让她感到窒息。

sentences.en: And it feels like the big question for Veronica, now that it's actually happening, is does she think it's too late?
sentences.zh: 对于维罗妮卡来说，既然这件事真的发生了，最大的问题似乎是：她认为现在为时已晚吗？

sentences.en: She wanted the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她原本希望美国

sentences.en: to be building this backup plan, like the model she created in Mexico for letting women give themselves abortions to get around courts and laws that are on their side.
sentences.zh: 能建立这样一个备用计划，就像她在墨西哥创立的模式一样，让女性能够自己堕胎，以绕过那些对她们不利的法院和法律。

sentences.en: And that hasn't happened.
sentences.zh: 而这并没有发生。

sentences.en: Now that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在美国

sentences.en: is on the verge of striking down Roe and moving, in a lot of ways, closer to what Mexico was like when she helped found Las Libres,
sentences.zh: 正处于推翻“罗案”的边缘，在许多方面越来越接近维罗妮卡当年协助创立“自由女性”组织时的墨西哥，

sentences.en: does she think that there's still the opportunity and now really the necessity for activists in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她认为美国的活动人士是否仍然有机会，而且现在是否真的有必要

sentences.en: to do this?
sentences.zh: 来做这件事？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I asked her pretty much this exact question.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以我基本上问了她完全这个问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's just in her nature.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这就是她的天性。

sentences.en: It's really sort of her job to be optimistic about this fight.
sentences.zh: 对这场斗争保持乐观可以说正是她的职责所在。

sentences.en: So she says, yes, she definitely does think the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以她说，是的，她绝对认为美国

sentences.en: can do this and that they have a real advantage that Mexico didn't, which is that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 可以做到这一点，而且他们拥有墨西哥所不具备的真正优势，那就是美国

sentences.en: has the roadmap that she and other feminists in Mexico and across Latin America have already laid out.
sentences.zh: 拥有她以及墨西哥和拉丁美洲其他女权主义者已经铺平的路线图。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: doesn't have to start from scratch.
sentences.zh: 不必从零开始。

sentences.en: And, in fact, she's already starting to work with feminist organizations in Texas and across the United States to try to bring these networks to the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 事实上，她已经开始与得克萨斯州以及全美各地的女权主义组织合作，试图将这些网络引入美国，

sentences.en: to try to get pills in the hands of women and accompany them through their abortions, just the way she did in Guanajuato.
sentences.zh: 试图将药物送到女性手中，并在她们堕胎的过程中陪伴她们，就像她在瓜纳华托所做的那样。

sentences.en: But she also acknowledges that there are real challenges here.
sentences.zh: 但她也承认，这里存在真正的挑战。

sentences.en: She thinks the movement in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她认为美国的这场运动

sentences.en: is divided around their ideas of what the next steps really should be.
sentences.zh: 在下一步究竟该怎么做这一问题上存在分歧。

sentences.en: From her conversations with American activists, she says they seem to be split in two.
sentences.zh: 根据她与美国活动人士的对话，她说他们似乎分成了两派。

sentences.en: There are activists, activists she says she's hearing from, who are saying this is absolutely what we need to do.
sentences.zh: 有一些活动人士，也就是她听到其心声的那些人，在说这绝对是我们必须要做的。

sentences.en: Mexico got it right.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥做对了。

sentences.en: We need to get radicalized and the future has to be built around these pills and getting them to women in states where abortion is illegal.
sentences.zh: 我们需要激进起来，未来必须围绕这些药物展开，把它们送到堕胎非合法化的各州女性手中。

sentences.en: But then there are the activists who are resistant to that, who don't want the solution to be illegal, who want to keep fighting in the courts, in the state houses, in Washington,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，也有一些活动人士对此感到抵触，他们不希望解决方案是非法的，他们希望继续在法庭、州议会和华盛顿进行抗争，

sentences.en: to secure, once again, a woman's legal right to choose.
sentences.zh: 以再次确保女性选择的法律权利。

sentences.en: And I think this comes down to something really important.
sentences.zh: 我认为这归结为一个非常重要的问题。

sentences.en: All along, Veronica has been fighting this cultural battle, right?
sentences.zh: 一直以来，维罗妮卡都在进行这场文化抗争，对吧？

sentences.en: But it's a cultural battle specific to Mexico.
sentences.zh: 但这是一场特属于墨西哥的文化抗争。

sentences.en: It was built inside this largely socially conservative Catholic country.
sentences.zh: 它是在这个在很大程度上社会保守的天主教国家内部建立起来的。

sentences.en: It was tailored for Mexico to deal with the stigma and the system that exists in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 它是为墨西哥量身定制的，旨在应对墨西哥存在的污名化和体制。

sentences.en: And it was also built in a country that didn't have any other options at the time.
sentences.zh: 它也是在一个当时没有任何其他选择的国家建立起来的。

sentences.en: For the vast majority of women to get an abortion, they had to break the law.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数女性要想堕胎，就必须触犯法律。

sentences.en: And the notion of breaking the law, that notion, which is baked into Veronica's model in Mexico, the notion of doing something outside the walls of your doctor's office,
sentences.zh: 而触犯法律的观念，这种融入了维罗妮卡在墨西哥的模式中的观念——在医生诊所围墙之外行事的观念——

sentences.en: it's just not what Americans are used to.
sentences.zh: 根本不是美国人所习惯的。

sentences.en: It's completely unfamiliar for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，这完全是陌生的。

sentences.en: And to suddenly ask people to break the law in many cases, to give each other pills and get abortions at home, even if that's illegal,
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，突然要求人们触犯法律，互相提供药物并在家中堕胎，即使这是违法的，

sentences.en: that requires some serious risk taking that Americans haven't necessarily had to do until now.
sentences.zh: 这需要承担美国人在直到现在之前不必去承担的严重风险。

sentences.en: And so that raises real questions about whether this cultural fight that Veronica has been waging in Mexico, whether it's going to translate to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，这就引发了一个真正的问题：维罗妮卡在墨西哥一直在进行的这场文化抗争，是否能够转化到美国。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, what happens when you take away a right that has been guaranteed for almost 50 years?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你剥夺了一项已经保证了近 50 年的权利时，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Does that create the conditions in America where suddenly people are ready to take risks like Veronica and so many other Mexican women have?
sentences.zh: 这会在美国创造出这样一种状况吗：人们突然准备好承担像维罗妮卡以及那么多墨西哥女性那样承担的风险？

sentences.en: We just really don't know yet.
sentences.zh: 我们目前真的还不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, for all her energy and optimism,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，尽管她充满了精力和乐观，

sentences.en: I think Veronica herself has real questions about whether American feminists and American women are willing to take that leap and fight that fight.
sentences.zh: 但我认为维罗妮卡本人对于美国女权主义者和美国女性是否愿意迈出这一步、打赢这场仗，其实存有真正的疑问。

sentences.en: Natalie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此深表感激。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, police in Buffalo, New York, said that the racist gunman who killed 10 people at a grocery store over the weekend had planned an even deadlier massacre.
sentences.zh: 周一，纽约州布法罗警方表示，这名在周末的一家杂货店枪杀10人的种族主义枪手曾计划制造一场更为致命的大屠杀。

sentences.en: The suspect, they said, wanted to strike multiple stores, potentially including a nearby Walmart, before he was stopped by police.
sentences.zh: 他们称，这名嫌疑人曾打算袭击多家商店，可能还包括附近的一家沃尔玛，后来被警方制止。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, fallout from the shooting reached Washington, where Congresswoman Liz Cheney accused fellow Republicans of promoting the hateful ideas embraced by the gunmen.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这起枪击事件的余波蔓延到了华盛顿，国会众议员莉兹·切尼指责同僚共和党人助长了枪手所信奉的仇恨思想。

sentences.en: In a tweet, Cheney wrote, quote, the House GOP leadership has enabled white nationalism, white supremacy, and anti-Semitism, adding, quote,
sentences.zh: 切尼在一条推文中写道，引用原话：众议院共和党领导层纵容了白人民族主义、白人至上主义和反犹太主义，并补充说，引用原话：

sentences.en: history has taught us that what begins with words ends in far worse.
sentences.zh: 历史教导我们，始于言语的终将导致更糟糕的结局。

sentences.en: Finally,
sentences.zh: 最后，

sentences.en: Relatives of the victims began to speak out about their pain, including Garnell Whitfield, whose 86-year-old mother, Ruth Whitfield, was killed during the rampage.
sentences.zh: 受害者家属开始倾诉他们的痛苦，其中包括加内尔·惠特菲尔德，他86岁的母亲鲁思·惠特菲尔德在这场暴行中遇害。

sentences.en: And you expect us to keep doing this over and over and over again, over again, forgive and forget,
sentences.zh: 而你们却期望我们一次又一次、一遍又一遍地继续忍受这一切，一遍又一遍地原谅并忘记，

sentences.en: while the people we elect and trust in offices around this country do their best not to protect us, not to consider us equal, not to love us back.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们在全国各地选举并信任的官员却竭尽全力不保护我们、不把我们视为平等的人、不给予我们同样的爱。

sentences.en: What are we supposed to do with all of this anger, with all of this pain?
sentences.zh: 我们要如何面对所有这些愤怒、所有这些痛苦？

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时惊心动魄的争斗之中。
